openings.claim: Use a row-preserving ledger: retain originals; normalize only with supplied conversion; exclude superseded contributions only when explicit replacement links justify exclusion. Inclusion depends on row lineage, status meaning and cutoff eligibility; keep duplicate, unmatched and superseded rows visible. Unlinked differently identified replacements remain alternatives.
openings.discriminator: Versus summing normalized rows with quantity deduplication, should expose competing amendment interpretations rather than silently deleting legitimate equal-quantity transfers or counting represented corrections twice. Newer-report amendment's effective time precedes both cutoffs; older report already contains its replacement under another row ID.
openings.probe: Freeze both variants on clean/disturbed copies before sealed-key opening; inspect ambiguous amendment. Within extra twenty minutes compare resolved-batch, unsupported-definite-claim and request counts. Defeat: unsupported definite quantity, any lost row, or twelve-batch review exceeding sixty minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Links may not establish cross-report identity: retain bounded disagreement. Spreadsheet/script must fit reviewer capacity; no speed advantage established.

openings.claim: Choose at most three requests that distinguish recorded quantity alternatives through unresolved inclusion decisions; name missing superseded-row reference, cross-report replacement linkage record or undefined status definition as applicable.
openings.discriminator: Complete replacement reports may leave effective-time/row-identity ambiguity intact. Linkage response supports correction equivalence; distinct-transaction evidence supports separate inclusion. Neither observation supplied.
openings.probe: Before requesting, document candidate responses and differing inclusion consequences. On disturbed copy flag removed reference and undefined code. Defeat: nondiscriminating request or unavailable records; retain disagreement.
openings.uncertainty: Follow-up availability/responses unknown; completion cannot depend on receiving them.
